privacy.intro: This policy covers the MouseEffect macOS app and this website, operated by Hiimob Apps. We keep the app’s effects local and explain the limited information involved in purchases, hosting and support below.
sections: Mouse events, only for live effects

The app observes global mouse movement, left-button press and release, left-button dragging and right-button presses. It derives click and double-click effects from these events. Event position, timing and click count are used in memory for immediate local rendering. The app does not save pointer histories or upload these events.
What the app does not monitor

MouseEffect does not globally monitor keyboard input, take screenshots, read screen contents, or replace or intercept the system pointer. Its transparent effect windows let mouse input pass through. Normal typing in the app’s own text fields is only used for the text you choose to enter.
Settings, presets and imported files

Settings, including the selected preset, intensity and motion preference, are stored locally with UserDefaults. Saved custom presets and imported particle assets are stored in the app’s local sandbox Application Support directory. Importing an image copies it to local app storage; it is not uploaded to us. Temporary drafts are not saved as presets and last for the current app session. Imported files may remain locally until cleaned up by the app.
Purchases are handled by Apple

StoreKit and the App Store handle product information, payment, transaction verification and restoration. The app reads the verified entitlement to unlock custom saving and activation. We do not operate a payment server or receive your card details. Apple processes purchase information under its own privacy policy.
No accounts, advertising or analytics

The app and website have no user accounts, advertising or analytics SDKs. We do not sell personal information, profile visitors or track them across sites. The website does not set analytics cookies or use local storage for tracking, and has no information submission forms.
Website hosting

GitHub Pages hosts this static website. When you request a page, GitHub may process basic hosting and security logs, including your IP address and technical request information, under GitHub’s privacy statement. This hosting activity is separate from the app’s local mouse rendering. The website loads its fonts and assets without third-party analytics.
Email support

If you email 494763134@qq.com, we receive your address and any information or attachments you voluntarily provide. We use them only to respond to and resolve your support request. Email providers also process delivery data under their own policies. Do not send payment credentials or other unnecessary sensitive information.
Retention, deletion and your choices

Local app data stays on your Mac until you delete it or the app removes unused assets. You can delete custom presets in the app. Removing the app alone may leave its sandbox data; ask support if you need help removing local data. You can pause effects at any time. We retain support correspondence only as needed to resolve the request and meet applicable legal obligations. Email us to request access, correction or deletion of support information; rights depend on applicable law. Apple and GitHub control their own records.
Security and children

Local processing limits data transfer, but no storage or email system is completely secure. The service is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information. A parent or guardian can contact us about information submitted through support.
Changes and contact
We will update this page and its effective date if our practices change. For privacy questions or requests, contact Hiimob Apps at 494763134@qq.com.

support.intro: A few quick ways to get your effects feeling right. MouseEffect requires macOS 27.0 or later and is coming soon to the Mac App Store. Its current interface is Chinese.
sections: Effects are not appearing

Check the main enable switch in the app or menu bar, then select a built-in preset. Check that the relevant gesture is enabled and its particle count and intensity are not too low. If needed, quit and reopen the app. MouseEffect does not require you to grant Accessibility or Input Monitoring permission for its mouse-only effects.
Pause effects or lower intensity

Use the menu bar switch to pause all effects. In general settings, lower the global intensity. Choose to follow the system’s Reduce Motion setting or always reduce motion. The website demo has its own pause control and starts paused when your browser requests reduced motion.
Free drafts and the one-time purchase

Built-in effects are free. You can create, edit and temporarily preview custom effects for free, but an unsaved draft lasts only for the current app session. Saving and activating a custom preset requires the one-time unlock. Previously saved presets remain visible and can be deleted if the entitlement is unavailable, but cannot be activated without it.
Restore a purchase

Open the custom effects purchase panel and choose Restore Purchases (恢复购买). Use the Apple Account that made the purchase and check your network connection. Apple verifies the entitlement. If the purchase is pending, wait for Apple’s confirmation. Do not buy it again to solve a restore issue; contact support if it persists.
Import text, Emoji or images

Choose text or Emoji in the particle editor, or import a valid PNG, JPEG or SVG file. The source file must be at most 30 MB and within the app’s image-size limits. Raster images are reduced to a maximum stored dimension of 512 pixels. If an import fails, try a smaller image or re-export it in a supported format. Assets are copied into local app storage.
Local settings and presets

Settings, custom presets and imported assets are kept on your Mac, without a developer cloud-sync service. Delete unneeded custom presets in the library. If you plan to remove all app data or change Macs, contact support for guidance before deleting local files. Removing the app alone may leave its sandbox data.
Availability and language

The app is not yet released. The download status on this site will change when it becomes available. This website has fourteen languages; the native app currently has a Chinese interface. The US$4.99 base price is a one-time purchase; the App Store shows the actual local price.
Contact Hiimob Apps

Email 494763134@qq.com with your macOS version, app version, what happened and what you expected. Screenshots are optional; remove private information before sending them. Never send passwords or payment details. We use the information you provide only to help with your request.
